newsitem.title: HUNGARY: HUNGARY NOON RADIO HEADLINES - MARCH 10.
newsitem.headline: HUNGARY NOON RADIO HEADLINES - MARCH 10.

text.p: These are the main headlines on Hungary's Kossuth Radio midday news. Reuters cannot vouch for their accuracy:
- The police expects 18,000 people and 11,000 vehicles to take part in road blockings at 182 places in the country, in a demonstration against the government's agricultural policies.

- Both Prime Minister Gyula Horn and Agricultural Minister Frigyes Nagy said that they are ready to negotiate with the representatives of agricultural producers about increasing tension in that sector of the economy.
- National Bank of Hungary President Gyorgy Suranyi expects the government's Sunday decision on cutting the monthly forint devaluation rate to 1.1 percent to help loan interest rates decrease.

- The largest trade union block, MSZOSZ said the discussion of the government's pension reform plans in the Interest Coordination Council should be cancelled as the plans, approved by the government on Sunday, are unclear at many points.
